title: Zesty Smoky Ukrainian Celeriac Bake
description: A smoky and gooey Ukrainian dish featuring celeriac, perfect for a cozy dinner, and easily made dairy-free-friendly
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced celeriac with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
In a separate bowl, mix the sauteed onion and garlic with vegan sour cream.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of celeriac slices.
Spread half of the sour cream mixture over the celeriac layer.
Repeat the layers, starting with the celeriac, then the remaining sour cream mixture, and finally another layer of celeriac on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley before serving.
